cards.ex: We should hit the road early to avoid traffic.
cards.exUz: Trafikdan qochish uchun erta yo'lga chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatga yoki uzoq joyga ketishni boshlamoq.

cards.ex: I prefer to travel off the beaten path and explore hidden gems.
cards.exUz: Men odamlardan uzoqda sayohat qilishni va yashirin gavharlarni o'rganishni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar kam boradigan, mashhur bo'lmagan joy.

cards.ex: I always try to travel light, just a backpack and a few essentials.
cards.exUz: Men doim yengil sayohat qilishga harakat qilaman, faqat ryukzak va bir nechta zarur narsalar bilan.
cards.uzDef: Kam narsalar bilan sayohat qilmoq.

cards.ex: She has a serious case of wanderlust and is always planning her next trip.
cards.exUz: Uda jiddiy sayohatga ishtiyoq bor va u doim o'zining keyingi sayohatini rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat qilishga kuchli xohish, dunyoni ko'rishga intilish.

cards.ex: As a flight attendant, she basically lives out of a suitcase.
cards.exUz: Styuardessa sifatida u asosan chamadonda yashaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p vaqtini sayohatda o'tkazmoq, doimiy joyi yo'q.

cards.ex: We roughed it in a tent for a week while hiking in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Biz tog'larda sayr qilganimizda bir hafta davomida chodirda qiyinchilikka chidadik.
cards.uzDef: Qulayliksiz, oddiy sharoitlarda sayohat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I'm starting to get itchy feet, I need to plan a vacation soon.
cards.exUz: Men sayohatga qizishni boshlayapman, tez orada ta'tilni rejalashtirishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat qilishni, yangi joylarni ko'rishni xohlamoq.

cards.ex: A weekend at the beach was just the change of scenery I needed.
cards.exUz: Dam olish kunini plyajda o'tkazish men uchun kerakli manzara o'zgarishi edi.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan boshqacha joy, yangi muhit.

cards.ex: She experienced culture shock when she first moved to Japan.
cards.exUz: U Yaponiyaga birinchi marta ko'chib kelganida madaniyat zarbasini boshdan kechirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi madaniyatga moslashishdagi qiyinchilik va hayrat.

cards.ex: Once you catch the travel bug, it's hard to stay in one place.
cards.exUz: Siz sayohat virusini yuqtirganingizdan so'ng, bir joyda qolish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat qilishga kuchli ishtiyoq, doim sayohat qilishni xohlamoq.

cards.ex: We didn't book a hotel, we're just going to wing it when we get there.
cards.exUz: Biz mehmonxona bron qilmadik, biz u yerga borganimizda vaziyatga qarab ish qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirmasdan, vaziyatga qarab ish qilmoq.

cards.ex: It's easy to get around the city by public transport.
cards.exUz: Shaharda jamoat transportida aylanib yurish oson.
cards.uzDef: Bir joydan boshqa joyga o'tmoq, sayohat qilmoq.

cards.ex: We sat at a cafe, soaking up the atmosphere of the old town.
cards.exUz: Biz qadimiy shaharning muhitidan zavqlanib, kafeda o'tirdik.
cards.uzDef: Joyning muhitini his qilmoq va undan rohatlanmoq.

cards.ex: This area is quite touristy, but it's still beautiful.
cards.exUz: Bu hudud juda turistik, lekin baribir chiroyli.
cards.uzDef: Turistlar ko'p boradigan, mashhur joy.

cards.ex: I always try to sample the local cuisine when I travel.
cards.exUz: Men sayohat qilganimda doim mahalliy taomlardan tatib ko'rishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Joyning an'anaviy taomlari.

cards.ex: The hotel is just a stone's throw away from the beach.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona plyajdan tosh otim masofada.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin joy.

cards.ex: We slept under the stars in the desert.
cards.exUz: Biz cho'lda yulduzlar ostida uxladik.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq havoda, yulduzlarni ko'rib dam olmoq.

cards.ex: We wanted to get off the beaten track and explore some smaller villages.
cards.exUz: Biz mashhur joylardan uzoqlashib, ba'zi kichik qishloqlarni o'rganmoqchi edik.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur bo'lmagan, odamlar kam boradigan joylarga sayohat qilmoq.

cards.ex: She's a seasoned traveler and knows all the best tips and tricks.
cards.exUz: U tajribali sayohatchi va eng yaxshi maslahatlar va hiylalarni biladi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p sayohat qilgan va tajribaga ega odam.

cards.ex: You can still have an amazing trip even if you travel on a budget.
cards.exUz: Agar siz tejamkor sayohat qilsangiz ham, ajoyib sayohatga ega bo'lishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kam pul bilan sayohat qilmoq.

cards.ex: This tiny island packs a punch with its stunning beaches and friendly locals.
cards.exUz: Bu kichik orol o'zining ajoyib plyajlari va do'stona mahalliy aholisi bilan katta ta'sir ko'rsatadi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik bo'lishiga qaramay, katta ta'sir ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: Traveling is all about making memories that will last a lifetime.
cards.exUz: Sayohat abadiy qoladigan xotiralar yaratish haqida.
cards.uzDef: Esda qolarli tajribalar orttirmoq.

cards.ex: We're planning to go backpacking across Europe next summer.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi yozda biz Yevropa bo'ylab ryukzak bilan sayohat qilishni rejalashtirmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Ryukzak bilan, arzon usulda sayohat qilmoq.

cards.ex: This is a once in a lifetime opportunity, we can't miss it.
cards.exUz: Bu umrda bir marta bo'ladigan imkoniyat, biz uni qo'ldan boy bera olmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bir marta bo'ladigan noyob imkoniyat.

cards.ex: I finally got around to booking my flight to Italy.
cards.exUz: Men nihoyat Italiyaga parvozimni bron qildim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga vaqt topmoq, qilishni boshlamoq.

cards.ex: We should check out the museum while we're in town.
cards.exUz: Biz shaharda ekanmiz, muzeyni ko'zdan kechirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyni tashrif buyurib, ko'rmoq va o'rganmoq.

cards.ex: I need to brush up on my Spanish before I go to Spain.
cards.exUz: Ispaniyaga borishimdan oldin ispan tilimni eslashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bilimlarni esga solmoq yoki takrorlamoq.

cards.ex: Don't put off booking your tickets, they might sell out.
cards.exUz: Biletingizni bron qilishni kechiktirmang, ular tugab qolishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani keyinroq vaqtga qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: I'm really looking forward to our vacation next month.
cards.exUz: Men kelgusi oyda bo'ladigan ta'tilimizni juda intizorlik bilan kutmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir bo'lishini xohlamoq va intizorlik bilan kutmoq.

cards.ex: Sometimes you just need to get away from it all and relax.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan siz shunchaki muammolardan uzoqlashib, dam olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammolardan va tashvishlardan uzoqlashib, dam olmoq.
